rule: Tickets are sold in the online ticket shop (ksc.de/tickets, tickets.ksc.de), from the day after the online start also in the FanWelt at the BBBank Wildpark and the Fanshop am Rondellplatz, and on matchday at the stadium box offices when tickets remain. Buying online needs a KSC-ID, a free registration with name, e-mail, address and date of birth; one e-mail address per KSC-ID.

Membership is not required for an ordinary home game, which reaches free sale. A passive adult membership (Klassik, 18+) costs EUR 75 a year from 1 Jul 2026 (EUR 70 reduced, EUR 90 Premium); 7-17 year-olds pay EUR 40; 0-6 year-olds are free but get no presale right. Membership starts once the application is processed and confirmed by e-mail, which currently takes up to 30 working days; the member's KSC-ID is then unlocked for members' presales.
note: ONE SOURCE, the club's own membership page; no second source for the fee was found. The club plans EUR 90 for every adult from July 2027 (EUR 80 with Supporters Karlsruhe membership). For the derby a membership is the practical route in (see free-sale-reached): two people need two memberships, since a KSC-ID carries one presale right. The processing time matters: an application made only when the sale is announced may not be processed in time.

rule: One presale right per KSC-ID: buying several season tickets on one KSC-ID still gives one right. Children's (0-6) and corporate memberships carry none.

note: ID on request is ATGB clause 2.6. Season tickets are always personalised (ATGB 4.1).

rule: The club's own Ticketzweitmarkt is the only legal platform for reselling and buying KSC home tickets. rule: The ticket terms forbid offering tickets on unauthorised platforms (named: viagogo, StubHub, Ticketbande, Gigsberg, eBay, eBay Kleinanzeigen, Facebook, seatwave) even without profit, and passing a ticket on above the original price; a mark-up of up to 15% for transaction costs is allowed. Tickets offered on unauthorised platforms can be cancelled without compensation.
note: ATGB 10.2. A private handover (illness, being prevented) is allowed under ATGB 10.3 through the Zweitmarkt or with the club told who the new holder is. The Landgericht Mannheim prohibited viagogo from selling unauthorised KSC tickets (K34, a legal blog's account, Jan 2026).

rule: A ticket may be passed on privately for non-commercial reasons, for example illness: through the club's Zweitmarkt, or directly if the new holder accepts the terms and the club is told, on request, the new holder's name, address and date of birth. rule: The club's own Ticketbörse is the only legal resale route. Day tickets can be listed only for sold-out games, from one week before; season-ticket seats from two weeks before. DOES NOT SIT EASILY WITH GERMANY'S DFL ROW (country-ticket-rules.csv, resale-price-cap): the DFL's fair-play rules cap the service fee for the official secondary market at 15% of the order value, and VfB keeps 20% from the seller. Either VfB is not one of the clubs in the DFL scheme (the DFL page does not say every club takes part), or the 15% means a buyer-side fee. Not settled; nothing changed on either side.

rule: Offering a ticket at auctions, on unauthorised platforms (named: eBay, eBay Kleinanzeigen, seatwave, viagogo, StubHub, ticketbande, ticketbis) or on social media is forbidden, as is any commercial resale. Tickets offered on unauthorised platforms give no right of entry, and the club pursues sellers with contractual penalties.

rule: The Fidelity Card "Fan Stadium Card", made with TicketOne, costs EUR 20.00 and lasts three years; it carries the holder's photo and expiry date and a barcode. It is issued only after an online Questura check: not for people under a stadium ban (DASPO), under prevention measures, or convicted (even not finally) of offences at sporting events.

rule: Forwarding works through the customer account or the FCK ticket app; the recipient needs an own account in the FCK online shop and must accept the ticket via an e-mailed link. rule: Commercial resale is banned. Buyers may not offer tickets publicly, at auctions or on platforms the club has not authorised (the terms name eBay, viagogo, seatwave, StubHub), pass them on regularly or in larger numbers, sell to dealers, or pass them to people banned from stadiums for security reasons. Passing a ticket to friends when prevented is allowed. Sanctions include cancelling the ticket and refusing entry, a ticket-sale ban of up to five years, surrender of the extra proceeds and loss of member privileges; the club says it pursues breaches together with a law firm.

rule: Day and season tickets for 2026/27 have four price levels: member (Mitglied, new in 2026/27 and cheaper than reduced), full price (Vollzahler), reduced (ermäßigt) and child under 18 (Kind U18).
